description: Search live Belgian or Luxembourg legal jobs on LexGO. Compact results without descriptions. Call get_job before recommending. Give the candidate click_url. Do not apply on their behalf.

experience_id.description: Experience band id from GET /api/v1/taxonomies (0 unknown, 1 0-3 years, 2 3-6, 3 +6).

language.description: Posting content locale (nl/fr/en), not required spoken languages.

q.description: Literal match on titles, employer name, and practice-area names. LIKE wildcards are treated as characters.

region_id.description: Address region id (Address::REGIONS). Never jobs.region_id. Also matches jobs posted for a whole area (Flanders, Wallonia, Belgium), which list every province they cover in regions.

name: search_jobs
title: Search LexGO jobs
